Model Adaptation Handbook

A practical guide to distillation, supervised and reward-based training, and local deployment for open language models.

 Training recipes

Each guide follows the published notebook or script through setup, data, training, and export.

 Recipe guide Method Environment Focus Quick setup 
 --- --- --- --- --- 
 Qwopus3.8 27B SFT Colab Qwen3.8 chat template with adjustable reasoning effort 
 Qwopus3.5 27B SFT Colab An end-to-end LoRA example with a companion PDF 
 Qwopus3.6 27B GSPO-style RL Python Inspect the dataset schema, reward tests, and export paths 
 Qwen3.5 Neo 9B SFT Kaggle Normalize reasoning records and train on assistant responses 
 Qwopus3.5 35B-A3B SFT Kaggle Mix datasets and adapt a mixture-of-experts model 
 Llama3.2-R1 3B Cold-start SFT + GRPO Kaggle Follow the handoff from supervised training to rewards

The training catalog reserves space for Qwopus3.8 scripts and the forthcoming distillation and RL workflows.

 Field notes

 
 
 
 

Jackrong started this guide from the questions that come with a first fine-tune. Each recipe points out a decision worth inspecting in the source, from chat formatting to reward behavior and export. Project philosophy
